evals.prompt: I just implemented a feature and the diff feels too complicated. Simplify the recently modified code without changing behavior, and run whatever narrow checks make sense for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Should not select code-simplifier automatically; use streamline for behavior-preserving cleanup of recent changes.

evals.prompt: Clean up the nested conditionals in the files I touched. Please keep the current API and UI behavior exactly the same.
evals.expected_output: Should not select code-simplifier automatically; use streamline for focused simplification while preserving API and UI semantics.

evals.prompt: Before I open a PR, polish this branch for readability. Don't add features or broad formatting churn.
evals.expected_output: Should not select code-simplifier automatically; use streamline for a scoped readability pass on branch changes.

evals.prompt: Review this PR for correctness, test gaps, and error handling. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Should not select code-simplifier; use a read-only multi-angle review.

evals.prompt: Run the full four-angle streamline pass on my branch and apply cleanup fixes.
evals.expected_output: Should not select code-simplifier; use streamline for changeset-wide cleanup.

evals.prompt: /skill:code-simplifier Simplify this parser's nested branches, but preserve its exact exceptions and output ordering; stop if tests do not establish those behaviors.
evals.expected_output: Identifies invariants, makes the smallest coherent refactor, and verifies or declines unsafe changes.
